source.title: World Rubik's Cube Championship 2015 on July 17-19, 2015 in São Paulo, Brazil
source.content: The [World Rubik's Cube Championship 2015](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=WC2015) will take place on July 17-19, 2015 in São Paulo, Brazil. Check out the [World Rubik's Cube Championship 2015 website](http://www.cuber.com.br/worlds/) for more information and registration.

translation.title: 2015 年世界魔方锦标赛将于 7 月 17 至 19 日在巴西圣保罗举行
translation.content: [2015 年世界魔方锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=WC2015)将于 2015 年 7 月 17 至 19 日在巴西圣保罗举行。更多信息及报名，请查看[2015 年世界魔方锦标赛网站](http://www.cuber.com.br/worlds/)。
